title: tldr-parser-ts
excerpt: tldr-parser-ts A lightweight, TypeScript-based parser designed to convert tldr markdown files into structured, type-defined data. It extracts command name, description and examples, according to…
content: tldr-parser-ts A lightweight, TypeScript-based parser designed to convert tldr markdown files into structured, type-defined data. It extracts command name, description and examples, according to their specification Features - Spec compliant : Parses standard tldr pages according to their specification - Lightweight : Only uses a single dependency, and the code has a minimal footprint! - Client support : Support for multiple clients, and structural design so that adding more tldr clients is easy - Full customization for parsing : Use the constraints you want for parsing queries! Installation Usage example Please, make sure you have a TLDR client available in your machine. This snippet works with tlrc
